_comment: EXAMPLE DATA ONLY — these three rules exist to show the shape and to prove the validator works.
Replace with real, verified fitment data before anything ships. A wrong rule here is somebody's disassembled engine (ADR-001 §2.4).
Rule shape: make + model + year_start..year_end + engine  →  platform.
Every field is required and must not be blank. Years are plain numbers. 'platform' must exactly match a handle in fitment/platforms.json.
Note rules 1 and 2: same truck, same years overlap in 1999 — the engine field is what decides the platform. That is why engine is required.
